'''Quoltus Firth''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]], who was once a musician. After his daughter, [[Aquella Firth]] began dating [[Niklas Cories]], a young man who helped out for the band [[Distraction]], Quoltus tried to stop her. After she ran away to go to a Distraction concert, Quoltus hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to investigate Cories. He was owed a favor by [[Zim Zimley]], a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who was the manager of the band, so he persuaded Zimley to hire the spacers, to provide extra security during a Distraction concert.
